MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Il Volo and Voyage II feel like natural next choices because expressive ensemble singing fits my interest in Il Divo, Under One Sky and Lead With Your Heart.",
    "Partners and I Dreamed A Dream appeal to the polished, theatrical singing I enjoy in Stages and A Musical Affair."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Willie Nelson and Clear As Day lean toward country when I currently want orchestral vocals or vocal ensembles; enjoying 747 and Golden does not mean every country recording appeals to me.",
    "Guardians of the Galaxy does not offer the same listening experience as the Downton Abbey recordings: a soundtrack connection alone does not capture my interest in gentle orchestral music.",
    "That's Christmas To Me fits my taste in vocal music, but I would not choose seasonal music right now. Christmas With Scotty McCreery also adds a country emphasis that interests me less."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My country purchases seem to have been treated as a broader preference than they represent in my current listening mood.",
    "My Christmas and soundtrack purchases seem to have been taken too broadly, without enough attention to the singing style, instrumentation or occasion."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The recurring appeal for me is expressive voices, ensemble harmonies and theatrical or orchestral accompaniment, rather than simply another familiar singer.",
    "My most recent choice of relaxing classical music suggests that calm listening matters now, while my earlier Christmas purchases do not necessarily reflect what I want today."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my interest in polished vocals, but stretch my country, Christmas and soundtrack purchases beyond what fits my current mood."
}
